~~~{=html}
<div class="fresnel-lab" data-fresnel-zones
     role="group" aria-label="Sum of the Fresnel-zone contributions of a thin layer at the observation point">
  <div class="fresnel-lab__controls">
    <label>Fresnel zones included, m
      <span data-zones-value>16</span>
      <input type="range" data-zones min="0" max="16" step="0.05" value="16">
    </label>
    <label>Cutoff of the outer rings, ε/k
      <span data-cutoff-value>none</span>
      <input type="range" data-cutoff min="0" max="0.3" step="0.01" value="0">
    </label>
  </div>
  <svg viewBox="0 0 1500 620" role="img"
       aria-label="Left: the layer and Fresnel zones; right: the sum of their contributions in the complex plane">
    <g data-zone-bands></g>
    <line class="fresnel-lab__ray" data-ray-top x1="110" y1="310" x2="600" y2="310"></line>
    <line class="fresnel-lab__ray" data-ray-bottom x1="110" y1="310" x2="600" y2="310"></line>
    <line class="fresnel-lab__axis-dashed" x1="110" y1="310" x2="600" y2="310"></line>
    <circle class="fresnel-lab__point" cx="600" cy="310" r="8"></circle>
    <text x="616" y="318">P</text>
    <text x="70" y="26">layer</text>
    <text x="330" y="298" text-anchor="middle">z ≫ λ</text>
    <text data-path-label x="330" y="600" text-anchor="middle">r = z + m·λ/2</text>

    <line class="fresnel-lab__axis" x1="770" y1="540" x2="1300" y2="540"></line>
    <line class="fresnel-lab__axis" x1="1020" y1="590" x2="1020" y2="50"></line>
    <text x="1300" y="575" text-anchor="end">in phase with the incident wave</text>
    <text x="1032" y="62">90° = factor i</text>
    <circle class="fresnel-lab__circle" cx="1020" cy="310" r="230"></circle>
    <path class="fresnel-lab__spiral" data-spiral></path>
    <line class="fresnel-lab__sum" data-sum x1="1020" y1="540" x2="1020" y2="540"></line>
    <polygon class="fresnel-lab__sum-head" data-sum-head points=""></polygon>
    <circle class="fresnel-lab__limit" data-limit r="9" cx="1020" cy="310"></circle>
    <text class="fresnel-lab__limit-label" data-limit-label x="1040" y="300">limit ≈ i</text>
    <text x="1480" y="90" text-anchor="end" class="fresnel-lab__key">dashed: without cutoff</text>
  </svg>
  <div class="fresnel-lab__bottom">
    <button type="button" data-play>Assemble the layer</button>
    <p class="fresnel-lab__readout" data-readout aria-live="polite"></p>
  </div>
</div>
~~~
